meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把任务拆成多个最小的、可独立合并的 PR；每个 PR 在独立 git worktree 中实现，先人工验证并保存证据，再写英文 PR，等 CI 和 Cubic 检查通过后自动合并，并清理工作目录。
howto.when: 当你说 “create a PR” 或 “implement and PR” 等关键词，或要求把工作以 PR 形式落地（即使是简单说 “implement X”）时触发。

say.text: 把这个问题拆成最小的原子 PR，按依赖顺序逐个交付。
say.note: 会先拆分，再逐个走完整生命周期。

say.text: 实现这个功能，并创建合并到 dev 分支的英文 PR。
say.note: 会进入验证循环，直到全部通过。

say.text: 合并前请做人工 QA，并把证据写进 PR。
say.note: 确保每次提交都有对应的人工验证证据。

howto.what_en: Decomposes a task into the smallest independently mergeable PRs, each implemented in its own worktree; requires evidence-bound manual QA, builds an English PR, iterates CI + Cubic until green (Cubic skipped only on quota), then auto-merges and cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'create a PR', 'implement and PR' (or similar), or simply asks to implement something with PR delivery implied.

say_en.text: Break this issue into minimal atomic PRs and deliver them in order.
say_en.note: It will split first, then run the full lifecycle per PR.

say_en.text: Implement this feature and create an English PR targeting the dev branch.
say_en.note: Runs the verification loop until everything passes.

say_en.text: Do a manual QA before merging and record the evidence in the PR.
say_en.note: Makes sure every commit has proof-backed QA.
